name: smwmusic-touhou-fuujinroku-mountain-of-faith-kappa-or-foe-akutagawa-ryuunosuke-s-kappa-candid-friend-remix
title: Touhou Fuujinroku ~ Mountain of Faith - Kappa or Foe ~ Akutagawa Ryuunosuke's Kappa ~ Candid Friend (Remix)
description:
𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐜𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐭 𝐁𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐲
𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝟓%.
𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐥’𝐬 𝐠𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐧, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭'𝐬 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨𝐨 𝐥𝐨𝐰!

Did an arrangement of Nitori Kawashiro's fantastic theme song, Akutagawa Ryuunosuke's Kappa ~ Candid Friend from Touhou 10: Mountain of Faith. Back at it with the Touhou 10 music in order to please the Goddesses at the Moriya Shrine. lmao.

Important:
There are customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Urban Legend in Limbo Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip (Voice Enabled, turned on default)
2. Disables Voice Clip (Voice Disabled)
